name: Browser
description: Chromium with a persistent profile: the agent opens sites, reads pages and fills in forms; live view and takeover
settings.headless.title: Headless mode
settings.headless.description: auto — a window if there is a display (Linux with DISPLAY, e.g. Xvfb in Docker), otherwise headless; always — always headless; never — always with a window
settings.idleMinutes.title: Close after inactivity, minutes
settings.allowLocalNetwork.title: Allow the agent to open local addresses
settings.allowLocalNetwork.description: localhost, 192.168.*, 10.* and the like. By default the agent cannot open addresses of this server or the local network
settings.takeoverWaitSec.title: Agent wait during takeover, seconds
settings.takeoverWaitSec.description: How long an agent tool waits for you to hand control of the browser back
settings.maxDownloadMb.title: Maximum download size, MB
ui.view.title: Browser
ui.activity.captcha: Captcha: take control and pass it
ui.status.user: You're in control — the agent is waiting
ui.stopped.title: The browser is not running
ui.stopped.hint: The agent starts it when needed and this window opens on its own. You can also open a site yourself: enter its address above.
ui.install.title: Installing Chromium
ui.install.hint: The browser is downloaded once, on first use. The agent's browser calls wait for it to finish.
ui.install.failed: Could not install Chromium: {detail}. It will try again the next time the browser is needed.
ui.screen.locked: Press “Take control” to click and type
ui.hint.user: Your clicks and keys go to the browser. When you're done (for example, solved a captcha or signed in), return control to the agent.
ui.hint.agent: This is the agent's browser, live. To solve a captcha or sign in yourself, press “Take control”.
ui.hint.touch: Tap to click, drag to scroll, “Keyboard” to type. When you're done, return control to the agent.
ui.keyboard.label: Type into the page
ui.call.fill_secret: Filled in data from the vault
ui.error.covered: The element is covered by another element (a banner, popup or dialog). Close it or scroll the page and try again.
ui.error.closed: The tab or the browser was closed.
ui.error.dns: Site not found (DNS error). Check the address.
ui.error.proxy: The hub's proxy refused the connection (the site is closed to the browser or the proxy is unavailable).
ui.error.noChromium: Chromium is not installed, and the automatic install is turned off or did not help. On the server, run: npx playwright install chromium
ui.error.installing: Chromium is still being installed (a one-time download). Try again in a minute.
ui.error.urlProtocol: Only http(s) addresses can be opened, not {protocol}
integration.summary: A real browser for the agent: websites, forms, screenshots, a live view you can take over
